_comment: Selected for capability, not cost. Only `model` is set, so upstream's per-agent reasoning-effort defaults still apply. `-pro` (reasoningMode) and `-fast` (priority serving) are mutually exclusive, so each agent takes one: depth for the reasoners and deep workers, latency for anything a human waits on. explore/librarian stay on the small luna model because they run in parallel and block the caller -- a bigger model is slower per token regardless of price. frontend-ui-ux-engineer/document-writer are skills, rejected by the schema's additionalProperties:false.
